location: The junction leading to the cellar levels
physicalConditions: Maren is carrying a broken cart axle across her shoulders, sustaining pain and strain on her injured leg/shoulder.
The corridor beyond the junction is dark and damp.
A hairline fracture in the masonry has been cleared to allow passage without triggering a trap.
knowledgeEstablished: Elara identified a secondary mechanical trap involving a hidden latch, pulley system, and weight-sensitive trigger beneath the floor slab at the junction.
The trap was bypassed by slipping through a hairline fracture in the wall rather than breaking stone or using magic.
The mechanism is sensitive to uneven weight distribution, vibrations, and sound.
No magical residue was found on the trap mechanism; it relies on raw engineering.
decisionsMade: Elias decided not to force the wall open but to find an architectural gap.
The party chose to slip through the cleared hairline fracture in the masonry.
Maren agreed to hold the axle steady while Elias inspected for alternate routes.
relationshipChanges: Torin expressed approval of the successful bypass.
Maren asserted her competence and ability to manage her injury without slowing the group.
completedActions: Elias stepped back from the wall after successfully slipping through the fracture.
Elara crouched by the base of the masonry to inspect the trap mechanism.
Torin assumed a guard position at the corridor ahead, hand on sword pommel.
Maren shifted her weight while managing the axle and pain.
Elias handed Elara a vial of loose quartz dust.
unresolvedImmediateAction: Elara is holding a small vial of loose quartz dust, preparing to inspect the floor or mechanism further as the group stands at the junction threshold.
continuationPosition: The group is positioned on the far side of the junction, having successfully bypassed the secondary trap.
